nodes.name: generic family H(Lambda, lambda, x)
nodes.statement:
We now replace every coefficient of $G$ (w.r.t the variables $x$ and $\lambda$) with a new variable $\Lambda$: set $ \b f(\Lambda,x)=\sum_{u \in Supp(f)} \Lambda_u x^u \ \text{and} \ \c P(\Lambda, \lambda. x) = \sum_{(\gamma, v) \in Supp(P)} \Lambda_{\gamma, v} \lambda^\gamma x^v$ and
\[
H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) := \b f(\Lambda,x)  +  \c P(\Lambda, \lambda. x) .
\]

nodes.name: Newton polytope of H
nodes.statement: As before, let $\Delta_{\infty}(H)$ denote the Newton polytope at infinity in $\bb R^{s+n}$ of $H$ (in $\lambda$ and $x$ variables).

nodes.name: cone and monoid M(H)
nodes.statement: Let $Cone(H)$ be the cone in $\bb R^{s+n}$ over $\Delta_{\infty}(H)$ and $M(H) = Cone(H) \cap \bb Z^{s+n}$ be the relevant monoid.

nodes.name: w_H dominates total weight
nodes.statement:
By our hypothesis that the $x$-support of $P$ is contained in $\Delta_{\infty}(f)$ we have the polyhedral weight function on this polytope $w_H$ dominates the total weight $w_{\text{tot}} := w_{\Gamma} + w_f$ relative to the polyhedron $\Gamma \times \Delta_{\infty}$; more precisely 
\[
w_{\text{tot}}(\gamma, u) \leq w_H(\gamma, u)
\]
for all $(\gamma, u) \in M(H)$.
conclusions: w_{\text{tot}}(\gamma, u) \leq w_H(\gamma, u)

nodes.name: coefficient rings K and K_0
nodes.statement:
We define $\c K := R[[\Lambda]]$ and 
\[
\c K_0 := \{ \xi \in \sum_{v \in \bb Z_{\geq 0}^t} \xi_v \Lambda^v \in \c K \mid \xi_v \rightarrow 0 \text{ as } v \rightarrow \infty \},
\]
where $t$ is the cardinality of $\{ Supp(f) \} \cup \{ Supp(P) \}$.

nodes.name: spaces W(K_0) and W_0(K_0)
spaces D(W(K_0)) and D_0(W_0(K_0))
modules S_0^*(W(K_0)) and S_0^*(W_0(K_0))
nodes.statement:
We define a $\c K_0$-module
\[
\c S^*_0(\c W(\c K_0)) := \{ \sum_{\gamma \in M(\Gamma), \b u \in S(M)} A_{\gamma, \b u}(\Lambda) \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} e_{\b u}^* \mid A_{\gamma, \b u} \in \c K_0 \}.
\]
and a $\c W_0(\c K_0)$-algebra
\[
\c S^*_0(\c W_0(\c K_0)) := \{ \sum_{\gamma \in M(\Gamma), \b u \in S(M)} \xi^*_{ \b u}(\Lambda, \lambda) e_{\b u}^* \mid \xi^*_{ \b u}(\Lambda, \lambda) \in \c W_0(K_0) \}.
\]

nodes.name: relative Frobenius F(Lambda, lambda, x)
nodes.statement:
We define a relative Frobenius map as follows. First, set
\begin{align*}
F(\Lambda, \lambda, x) &:= \prod_{u \in Supp(f)} \theta(\Lambda_u x^u) \cdot \prod_{(\gamma, v) \in Supp(P)} \theta( \Lambda_{\gamma, v} \lambda^\gamma x^v) \\
F_m(\Lambda, \lambda, x) &:= \prod_{i=0}^{m-1} F(\Lambda^{p^i}, \lambda^{p^i}, x^{p^i}),
\end{align*}
and note that, similar to before,
\[
F_m(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = \sum_{(\gamma, u) \in M(H)} \c F^m_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \lambda^{\gamma} x^u 
\]
with $\c F^m_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda)= B_{\gamma,u}(\Lambda) \tilde{\pi}^{w_{tot}(\gamma,u)/p^{m-1}} = \b B_{\gamma,u}(\Lambda) \tilde{\pi}^{w_H(\gamma,u)/p^{m-1}}$.

nodes.name: Relative dual Frobenius alpha^*_{m,Lambda}
nodes.statement:
It follows that, if we set (as before)
\[
\alpha_m^*(\Lambda, \lambda) := \text{pr}_{M(f)} \circ F_m(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \circ \Phi_x^m,
\]
where $\Phi_x$ sends $x^u \mapsto x^{pu}$ and $\text{pr}_{M(f)}$ was defined above, then an argument similar to Lemma \ref{L: better conv} shows
\[
\alpha_{m, \Lambda}^*: \c D_0(\c W_{0, p^m}(\c K_0)) \rightarrow \c D_0(\c W_{0, p^m}(\c K_0)),
\]
where $\c W_{0, p^m}$ is defined by replacing $\tilde \pi^{w_\Gamma}$ with $\tilde \pi^{w_{p^m \Gamma}}$ in the definition of $\c W_0$. Furthermore, 
\[
\alpha_{m, \Lambda}^*(\tilde \pi^{-w(v)} x^{-v}) = \sum_{u \in M(f)} C_{u, v}(\Lambda, \gamma) \tilde \pi^{-w(u)} x^{-u}
\]
with $C_{u, v}(\Lambda, \lambda) \in \c W_{0, p^m}(\c K_0)$ and $C_{u, v}(\Lambda, \lambda) \rightarrow 0$ as $w(u) \rightarrow \infty$.
conclusions: \alpha_{m, \Lambda}^*: \c D_0(\c W_{0, p^m}(\c K_0)) \rightarrow \c D_0(\c W_{0, p^m}(\c K_0)),
nodes.statement_short: The relative dual Frobenius $\alpha^*_{m,\Lambda}$ preserves $\c D_0(\c W_{0,p^m}(\c K_0))$, with decaying matrix entries.

nodes.name: relative [alpha_m^*]_kappa
nodes.statement: For any $\kappa \in \bb{Z}_p$, we define $[\alpha^*_m]_{\kappa} : \c S^*_{0,p^m}(\c W_0(\c K_0)) \rightarrow \c S^*_{0,p^m}(\c W_0(\c K_0))$ using (\ref{E: number14}).

nodes.name: Relative beta^* is an endomorphism
nodes.statement:
By an argument similar to Lemma \ref{L: beta is endo}, the map
\[
\beta_{\kappa, \bar t, \Lambda}^*: \c S^*_0(\c W(\c K_0)) \rightarrow \c S^*_0(\c W(\c K_0))
\]
defined by 
\[
\beta_{\kappa, \bar t, \Lambda}^* := \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [ \alpha_{a d(\bar t)}^* ]_\kappa  \circ \Phi_\lambda^{a d(\bar t)}.
\]
is an endomorphism over $\c K_0$.
conclusions: is an endomorphism over $\c K_0$

nodes.name: M_0 sets
nodes.statement: Set $M_0(\Gamma) = M(\Gamma) \cap (- M(\Gamma)), M_0(f) = M(f) \cap (- M(f)), \ \text{and} \ M_0(H) = M(H) \cap (-M(H))$.

nodes.name: projection pr_0
nodes.statement:
Define the projection map 
\[
\text{pr}_0: \quad  \sum_{\gamma \in \bb Z^s, u \in \bb Z^n} C(\gamma, u) \lambda^\gamma x^u \longmapsto \sum_{\gamma \in M_0(\Gamma), u \in M_0(f)} C(\gamma, u) \lambda^\gamma x^u.
\]

nodes.name: coefficients A_{gamma,u}(Lambda)
nodes.statement: Let us write then $\exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = \sum A_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \lambda^\gamma x^u$ with $A_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \in R[[\Lambda]]$ and the indices $(\gamma, u) \in M(H) \subset M(\Gamma) \times M(f)$.

nodes.name: J and J-tilde coefficients
nodes.statement:
We will also write 
\[
pr_0( \exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) ) = \sum_{(\gamma, u) \in M_0(\Gamma) \times M_0(f)} J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma) -w(u)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u} =  \sum_{(\gamma, u) \in M_0(H)} \tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \tilde \pi^{-w_H(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u}.
\]

nodes.name: Relation between J, J-tilde and A
nodes.statement: J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) = A_{-\gamma, -u}(\Lambda) \tilde \pi^{w_\Gamma(\gamma) + w(u)} = \tilde{J}_{\gamma,u} \tilde{\pi}^{ w_{\Gamma}(\gamma)+w(u) -w_H(\gamma,u) }
nodes.label: E: J's

nodes.name: eigenvector eta
nodes.statement:
Define 
\begin{align} \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) :&= \frac{1}{ J_{00}(\Lambda) } \text{pr}_0 \exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \notag \\
&= 1 + \sum_{\substack{ (\gamma, u) \in M_0(H)  \\  (\gamma, u) \not= (0,0)}} \frac{\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda)}{J_{0,0}(\Lambda)} \tilde \pi^{-w_H(\gamma,u)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u}. 
\end{align}

nodes.name: Eigenvector eta
nodes.statement: \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) :&= \frac{1}{ J_{00}(\Lambda) } \text{pr}_0 \exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \notag \\ &= 1 + \sum_{\substack{ (\gamma, u) \in M_0(H) \\ (\gamma, u) \not= (0,0)}} \frac{\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda)}{J_{0,0}(\Lambda)} \tilde \pi^{-w_H(\gamma,u)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u}.
nodes.label: E: eigenvector

nodes.name: Convergence of J ratios on the closed polydisk
nodes.statement: In \cite{MR2966711}, it was shown that $J_{0,0}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda^p)$ and $\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ converge on the closed unit polydisk $| \Lambda | \leq 1$ for every $\Lambda$. Equivalently, $J_{0,0}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda^p)$ and $ \tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ belong to $\c K_0$.
conclusions: $J_{0,0}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda^p)$ and $\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ converge on the closed unit polydisk $| \Lambda | \leq 1$ for every $\Lambda$
nodes.statement_short: The ratios $J_{0,0}(\Lambda)/J_{0,0}(\Lambda^p)$ and $\tilde J_{\gamma,u}/J_{0,0}$ converge on the closed unit polydisk.

nodes.name: J/J_{0,0} lies in K_0
nodes.statement: The same holds as well for $ J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ using (\ref{E: J's}), since $A_{-\gamma,-u}(\Lambda) \in R[[\Lambda]]$.
conclusions: The same holds as well for $ J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$

nodes.name: eta lies in D_0(W_0(K_0))
nodes.statement:
Since $J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) = A_{-\gamma, -u} \tilde \pi^{w_\Gamma(\gamma) + w(u)}$, we have
\[
\left| \sum_{\gamma \in M_0(\Gamma)} \frac{J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda)}{ J_{0,0}(\Lambda)} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} \right| \leq |\tilde \pi |^{w(u)},
\]
and so $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \in \c D_0(\c W_0(\c K_0)) \subset \c D( \c W(\c K_0))$.
conclusions: $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \in \c D_0(\c W_0(\c K_0)) \subset \c D( \c W(\c K_0))$

nodes.name: Frobenius ratio F(Lambda)
nodes.statement: Set $\c F(\Lambda) := J_{00}(\Lambda) / J_{00}(\Lambda^p)$.

nodes.name: Dual Frobenius on eta up to error
nodes.statement:
Observe that 
 \[\text{pr}_{M(f)} \circ F_m(\Lambda,\lambda,x) \circ \text{pr}_0 (\exp \pi H(\Lambda^p,\lambda^p,x^p)) = \text{pr}_{M(f)}  (\exp \pi H(\Lambda,\lambda,x))
\]
so that
\begin{align*}
\alpha_{1, \Lambda}^*( \eta(\Lambda^p, \lambda^p, x) ) &= \c F(\Lambda) \text{pr}_{M(f)} \left( \frac{\exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x)}{J_{00}(\Lambda)} \right) \\
&= \c F(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  + \tilde \omega (\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
\end{align*}
where each $\lambda^\gamma$ appearing in $\tilde \omega$ lies in $M(\Gamma) \setminus M_0(\Gamma)$.
conclusions:
\alpha_{1, \Lambda}^*( \eta(\Lambda^p, \lambda^p, x) ) &= \c F(\Lambda) \text{pr}_{M(f)} \left( \frac{\exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x)}{J_{00}(\Lambda)} \right) \\
&= \c F(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  + \tilde \omega (\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right)
nodes.statement_short: $\alpha^*_{1,\Lambda}$ maps $\eta(\Lambda^p,\lambda^p,x)$ to $\c F(\Lambda)(\eta+\tilde\omega)$ with $\tilde\omega$ supported off $M_0(\Gamma)$.

nodes.name: Iterated eigenvector formula
nodes.statement:
Iterating this, if we set
\[
\c F_m(\Lambda) := \prod_{i=0}^{m-1} \c F(\Lambda^{p^i}),
\]
then we have
\begin{equation} \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
\end{equation}
where each $\lambda^\gamma$ appearing in $\omega$ lies in $M(\Gamma) \setminus M_0(\Gamma)$.
conclusions: \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
nodes.statement_short: Iterating gives $\alpha^*_{ad(\bar t),\Lambda}\eta(\Lambda^{q},\lambda^{q},x)=\c F_{ad(\bar t)}(\Lambda)(\eta+\omega)$.

nodes.name: First formula
nodes.statement: \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
nodes.label: E: first formula

nodes.name: Q_{gamma,u}
nodes.statement:
For notational convenience, set $Q_{\gamma, u} := Q_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) := J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ so that
\[
\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = 1 + \sum_{\substack{\gamma \in M_0(\Gamma), u \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma, u) \not= (0, 0)}} Q_{\gamma, u} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma) - w(u)} \lambda^{-\gamma}  x^{-u}.
\]

nodes.name: Computation of (Upsilon(eta))^kappa
nodes.statement:
For $\kappa \in \bb Z_p$, we compute
\begin{align*}
(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa &= \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l}(\sum Q_{\gamma, u} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} e_u^*)^l \\
&= \sum_{l=0}^\kappa \binom{\kappa}{l} \sum_{\substack{\gamma_1, \ldots, \gamma_l \in M_0(\Gamma) \\ u_1, \ldots, u_l \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma_j, u_j) \not= (0, 0) \text{ for every j}} } Q_{\gamma_1, u_1} \cdots Q_{\gamma_l, u_l} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1) - \cdots - w_\Gamma(\gamma_l)} \lambda^{-(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} e_{u_1}^* \cdots e_{u_l}^* \\
&= \sum_{l = 0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \sum_{\substack{\gamma_1, \ldots, \gamma_l \in M_0(\Gamma) \\ u_1, \ldots, u_l \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma_j, u_j) \not= (0, 0) \text{ for every j}} } \widetilde{Q}_{\gamma, u} \cdot \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} \lambda^{-(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} e_{u_1}^* \cdots e_{u_l}^*
\end{align*}
where
\[
\widetilde{Q}_{\gamma, u} := Q_{\gamma_1, u_1} \cdots Q_{\gamma_l, u_l} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1) - \cdots - w_\Gamma(\gamma_l) + w_\Gamma(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)}.
\]
nodes.statement_short: Binomial expansion of $(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa$ in the $Q_{\gamma,u}$.

nodes.name: (Upsilon(eta))^kappa lies in S^*(W_0(K_0))
nodes.statement: Hence, $(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa \in \c S^*(\c W_0(\c K_0))$.
conclusions: $(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa \in \c S^*(\c W_0(\c K_0))$

nodes.name: Support argument for omega/eta
nodes.statement: As every $\lambda^\gamma$ appearing in $\Upsilon(\omega)$ (from equation (\ref{E: first formula})) satisfies $\gamma \in M(\Gamma) \setminus M_0(\Gamma)$, it follows that the same is true for $( \Upsilon(\omega) / \Upsilon(\eta) )^r$ for any $r \in \bb Z_{\geq 1}$.
nodes.statement_short: Powers of $\Upsilon(\omega)/\Upsilon(\eta)$ keep support outside $M_0(\Gamma)$.

nodes.name: Projection kills the error term
nodes.statement:
Hence,
\[
\text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \left(1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega)}{\Upsilon(\eta) } \right)^\kappa  = 1.
\]
conclusions: \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \left(1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega)}{\Upsilon(\eta) } \right)^\kappa  = 1.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1.1 (unit root formula)
nodes.statement:
We may now finish the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}. For convenience, write $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = 1 + h(\Lambda, \lambda, x)$ so that $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa = (1 + \Upsilon(h))^\kappa = \sum_{l=0}^\infty  \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon(h)^l$. Observe that 
\begin{align*}
\beta_{\kappa, \bar t, \Lambda}^* \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa &= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \circ \Phi_\lambda^{a d(\bar t)} \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa  \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon \left( h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x)  \right)^l \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \left(\Upsilon \circ \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 \right)^{\kappa - l} \left(\Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^l \qquad \text{by definition of $ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa$} \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \> \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 + \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \left( \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  \right)^\kappa \qquad \text{by } (\ref{E: first formula}) \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa \left( 1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}{\Upsilon( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}  \right)^\kappa \\
&= \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa.
\end{align*}
Finally, we may specialize this equality taking  $\Lambda$ at the Teichm\"uller unit coefficients of $\hat G(\hat t, \lambda, x)$:
\[
\Lambda_u = \hat t_u \qquad \text{and} \qquad \Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v) \qquad \text{for all $u$ and $\gamma, v$ in the support of $H$},
\] 
and setting
\[
\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x) := \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \text{ specialized at $\Lambda_u = \hat t_u$ and $\Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v)$} \right),
\]
then we see that
\begin{equation} \beta_{\kappa, \bar t}^* \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa 
\end{equation}
This demonstrates that $\c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa$ is the unique unit root of $L^{(0)}(\kappa, \bar t, T)^{(-1)^{s+1}}$ by (\ref{E: L0  and dual}), which, together with Theorem \ref{T: unique unit}, completes the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}.
nodes.statement_short: Show $\Upsilon(\eta_{sp})^\kappa$ is an eigenvector of $\beta^*_{\kappa,\bar t}$ with eigenvalue $\c F_{ad(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa$. Then the dual determinant formula (20) and Theorem 3.1 identify it as the unique unit root.

nodes.name: Finish the main proof
nodes.statement: We may now finish the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}.
nodes.statement_short: Announce the final step of the proof of Theorem 1.1.

nodes.name: Write eta = 1 + h
nodes.statement: For convenience, write $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = 1 + h(\Lambda, \lambda, x)$ so that $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa = (1 + \Upsilon(h))^\kappa = \sum_{l=0}^\infty  \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon(h)^l$.
nodes.statement_short: Write $\eta=1+h$ and expand $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa$ binomially.

nodes.name: Eigenvector computation
nodes.statement:
Observe that 
\begin{align*}
\beta_{\kappa, \bar t, \Lambda}^* \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa &= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \circ \Phi_\lambda^{a d(\bar t)} \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa  \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon \left( h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x)  \right)^l \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \left(\Upsilon \circ \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 \right)^{\kappa - l} \left(\Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^l \qquad \text{by definition of $ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa$} \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \> \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 + \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \left( \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  \right)^\kappa \qquad \text{by } (\ref{E: first formula}) \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa \left( 1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}{\Upsilon( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}  \right)^\kappa \\
&= \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa.
\end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Compute $\beta^*$ on $\Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q},\lambda,x))^\kappa$ using (23) and the projection lemma, obtaining eigenvalue $\c F_{ad(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa$.

nodes.name: Specialize at Teichmuller point
nodes.statement:
Finally, we may specialize this equality taking  $\Lambda$ at the Teichm\"uller unit coefficients of $\hat G(\hat t, \lambda, x)$:
\[
\Lambda_u = \hat t_u \qquad \text{and} \qquad \Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v) \qquad \text{for all $u$ and $\gamma, v$ in the support of $H$},
\] 
and setting
\[
\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x) := \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \text{ specialized at $\Lambda_u = \hat t_u$ and $\Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v)$} \right),
\]
then we see that
\begin{equation} \beta_{\kappa, \bar t}^* \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa 
\end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: Specialize $\Lambda$ at the Teichm\"uller coefficients to get the eigenvector equation (24).

nodes.name: Identify the unit root
nodes.statement: This demonstrates that $\c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa$ is the unique unit root of $L^{(0)}(\kappa, \bar t, T)^{(-1)^{s+1}}$ by (\ref{E: L0  and dual}), which, together with Theorem \ref{T: unique unit}, completes the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}.
nodes.statement_short: By (20) and Theorem 3.1 the eigenvalue is the unique unit root.

nodes.name: Unit root eigenvector equation
nodes.statement: \beta_{\kappa, \bar t}^* \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa
nodes.label: E: unit root dual
